description:
Retrieve voices with filtering and pagination support. ElevenLabs
and Cartesia support advanced filtering by name, language, accent,
and gender.
Other providers support basic pagination only.

(Tags: Providers)

gender.description: Filter voices by gender. ElevenLabs and Cartesia.

language.description: ISO language code (e.g. `en`, `hi`, `es`). ElevenLabs and Cartesia.

provider.description: TTS provider to list voices from. Omit to list across all providers.

search.description: Substring match against voice name or description. ElevenLabs and Cartesia.

name: listVoices
